protocol: "The 22 to 23 September publishing gap stays in. It is not deleted or patched. Results are reported with it included, and the jobs that straddle it are reported separately so its effect is visible." Reaffirmed by A1.6.
code: scripts/20_analyse_results.py: "main_set = w[~w.touches_gap]", then both confirmatory comparisons run on main_set. The gap set is printed separately under "THE 22 TO 23 SEPTEMBER GAP, reported separately (EXPLORATORY)".
note: The separate reporting is done, but the headline excludes the gap jobs instead of including them. This script supplies the included version. Found in L-052.

protocol: "(B) per-field shrinkage against stale, at D = 6 hours and D = 24 hours, pooled over machines and circuits, on the test days only."
code: scripts/20_analyse_results.py: PRIMARY_B_DELAYS = [6, 24], then "sub = main_set[main_set.delay_h.isin(PRIMARY_B_DELAYS)]" and one block_boot over that combined set is printed as the headline, with the per-delay numbers printed under it.
note: The protocol pools over machines and circuits AT EACH D, which is two numbers. Script 20 headlines a third number that also pools the two delays together. Both are printed, so no number is hidden, but the headlined one is not the one the protocol defines. This script reports the two per-delay numbers first.

code: The results file carries label TEST only, and script 20 takes the file as given without re-filtering by date.
note: Checked: every row in the file has label TEST, and every t_s falls on or after the A1.6 test start of 21 September.

code: engine_config.DELAYS_H = [1, 3, 6, 12, 24, 48]; script 20 groups by delay_h and never filters a delay out.
run_engine.CIRCUIT_ORDER lists exactly those five; script 20 never filters a circuit out and pools over them.

protocol: "invalid jobs are dropped and counted, never silently skipped ... The count dropped per D is reported." A1.7: "Jobs whose truth state falls outside the data are dropped and counted, with the count reported per delay D."
code: engine/jobs.py build_jobs returns (jobs, dropped) and the run log records the per-delay counts. scripts/20_analyse_results.py does NOT print them; scripts/24_prereg_outputs.py does, as P7_dropped_jobs_per_delay.csv.
note: The obligation is met, but by script 24 rather than by the headline script. Worth knowing when reading script 20 alone.

protocol: "Every result is reported against all three of these: queue delay D; age at run time of the cz numbers; number of new states between t_s and t_r." Readout age "shown separately, never merged".
code: scripts/20_analyse_results.py reports delay and new states. The cz age axis and the separate readout age live in scripts/24_prereg_outputs.py as P1, P1b, P2 and P2b.
note: Same shape as the row above: the axis exists, in script 24.

protocol: "analytic estimated success probability ... reported alongside the simulated fidelity, never instead of it."
code: The engine writes an esp column for every row. Script 20 does not print ESP; scripts/24_prereg_outputs.py does, as P3_esp_alongside_fidelity.csv.

protocol: "a block bootstrap that resamples WHOLE DAYS, so jobs from the same day stay together."
code: scripts/20_analyse_results.py block_boot resamples frame.day.unique(), where day is the calendar date of t_s, pooled across machines.
note: A calendar day, not a machine-day. Section 17 risk 4 names machine-days as the alternative and declines it, because the gap was platform wide, so the calendar day is the choice the protocol points to.

protocol: "dead if sx_error > 0.1 or readout_error > 0.2 or T1 missing or T2 missing", applied to the state THAT STRATEGY SEES, with permanent defects excluded for every strategy.
code: engine_config.SX_DEAD = 0.1, RO_DEAD = 0.2; real_data.strategy_target forbids dead_qubits(snap) plus the permanent set. Permanent defects come from training days only, which is Amendment A1.5.

topic: Tie handling in the shrinkage tuning
protocol: Section 6 says N and w are tuned on training days and recorded in an amendment before test days are touched. It sets no tie-break rule.
code: engine_config.py: "Chosen by the pre-registered rule: lowest mean ESP regret vs the ceiling, ties to smaller N, then to smaller total w."
note: The tie-break is in Amendment A2, and A2.2 records honestly that w_times was settled by the tie-break and not by evidence; A3.1 later fixed it by evidence instead.

protocol: Four checks, and no number may be reported until all pass.
code: scripts/20_analyse_results.py sanity() implements all four and exits 1 unless --allow-failed-checks is given.

protocol: "For every D, report the share of jobs where no new state appeared between t_s and t_r."
code: scripts/20_analyse_results.py prints the no-change share in the Comparison A table for every delay.

protocol: "Everything else is exploratory and must be labelled exploratory wherever it appears."
code: scripts/20_analyse_results.py prints "EXPLORATORY from here down. Not confirmatory. Do not headline." before the rest.

protocol: "Training days: 28 August to 28 September 2026 (32 days). Test days: 29 September to 12 October 2026 (14 days)."
note: Amendment A1.6 moved the split to 24 training and 22 test days and recorded the consequence that the gap moved into the test window.
